276042343.description:
Description:
This large assorted rock, mineral, and gemstone collection is suitable for beginners and enthusiasts. It includes three boxed collections: Beginner's Rock Collection, Rocks and Minerals to Meet the Demands of Space Age Technology, and Ozark Collection. Each box contains labeled specimens of minerals, rocks, and gemstones such as agate, obsidian, sulphur, copper ore, and others. The lot also contains multiple compartmentalized storage boxes and bags with a wide variety of loose stones, tumbled stones, rough mineral samples, and labeled specimens including purple smithsonite, quartz, aventurine, chryscolla, blue topaz, garnet, peridot, and emerald. Additional items include tumbled stones set in wire cages for necklaces, a velvet pouch, and a tin with more rocks. Most items show signs of use or vintage wear, with some wear on boxes.
Dimensions:
10 x 12 x 10 in
Product Weight
11 lb

Items consist of tumbled and raw stones, agate slices, quartz pieces, coral fragments, a crystal sphere, mineral cluster, and a labeled Arizona rock specimen. Also included are decorative display pieces such as a wire-wrapped gemstone tree and a large polished agate slice. Most pieces are small to medium-sized, with conditions ranging from raw and natural to polished. No visible brand markings are present. Suitable for collectors or educational purposes.

275179989.description: This lot includes 9 natural mineral specimens primarily composed of selenite, a crystalline form of gypsum. The pieces range in translucency from translucent to transparent and exhibit a pearly luster. Most specimens are colorless or white, with one showing a light tan hue. The crystals display characteristic striated and bladed formations and are in raw, unpolished condition with some natural edge chipping. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.
